anchors.description: Long edge of the single flat white sheet of paper lying on the bedspread, measured from its left corner to its right corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: One flat white rectangular sheet on the pink bedspread, straight sharp edges, slightly raised right end with a shadow step under it; the left-right edge is clearly the longer of the two edge directions.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No markings or brand visible, so exact format unknown: US Letter (0.279 m) vs A4 (0.297 m) sheet; a smaller notepad/note card (~0.20-0.22 m) is a less likely alternative, and endpoints may sit a few pixels inside the true corners, which would shorten the measured span slightly.
